novelty_basis: S. Rajagopalan, L. J. Schulman, Verification of identities, SIAM J. Comput. 29 (2000) 1155-1168.
proof_check: one-sidedness proved (proofs/paper/C17.md Theorem 3, bilinear extension); the 1/8 detection bound is the cited theorem of Rajagopalan-Schulman, not re-proved; empirically 0 errors in 90 instances with 40 rounds
statement: The GF(2) subset-sum test (compare (u*v)*w and u*(v*w) in the magma algebra for random subsets u, v, w) never rejects an associative table, and rejects a non-associative one with probability at least 1/8 per round; each round costs O(n^2) probes.
title: The Rajagopalan-Schulman randomised associativity test is one-sided
